verdict.root_cause: The agent tried to save the date before opening the Announcements page and reading the most recent notice. It also never collected a notice title.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent caused the outcome: after navigation it remained on the Dashboard and, at step 0-2, stated that the date was stored even though the visible page contained only an Announcements card with a “View announcements” link. It did not follow that link or inspect the notices, so the required title and date could not be found.
